verdict.rationale: Segment's own Engage docs say marketers can build Audiences from tracking events, traits, and computed traits, and sync them to destinations, so the core of the story is a documented product capability. The evidence never mentions a visual builder, never confirms no SQL is needed, and never shows an estimated audience size before activation. missing for 10: evidence of a visual/no-code builder, explicit no-SQL workflow, audience size estimate before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: You can build Audiences from core **tracking events**, **traits**, and **computed traits**. You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of [Destinations]
Audiences let you group users or accounts based on event behavior and traits that Segment tracks.
Twilio Engage is a customizable personalization platform with which you can build, enrich, and activate Audiences.
